perfumes.name: Decision
perfumes.description: Frankincense and myrrh smoke drift over crushed juniper berries and cardamom, cut with a bright flash of bergamot. Vanilla and cedar slowly settle the air, the hush of a stone chapel just after its doors swing open onto a cold, sunny street.

perfumes.name: Dia Woman 40
perfumes.description: A burst of sparkling aldehydes and white musk lifts cyclamen, rose and carnation into the brightness of freshly pressed linen in a sunlit room. Orris and sandalwood soften the finish into the powdery calm of a silk scarf taken from a cedar drawer.

perfumes.name: Existence
perfumes.description: Aldehydes flash over lily of the valley and dewy rose, the clean shine of a white-tiled bathhouse filled with fresh flowers. Frankincense, benzoin and white musk warm the skin underneath with a soft amber glow that stays close and quiet.

perfumes.name: Gold Woman
perfumes.description: Lily of the valley, rose and jasmine bloom over civet, musk and frankincense, the opulence of a golden ballroom in 1980s Muscat. Orris and sandalwood leave a powdery, fur-soft trail that belongs with evening gloves and pearls.

perfumes.name: Guidance 46
perfumes.description: Rose water and juicy pear meet roasted hazelnut and bitter almond, a pastry-shop window glowing on a frosty evening. Creamy sandalwood and vanilla carry the rose deep into the night, richer and darker than the original Guidance.

perfumes.name: Honour Man
perfumes.description: Cracked black and pink pepper burn bright over geranium and elemi, then frankincense smoke curls through vetiver and cedar. It is crisp tailoring and a starched white shirt, worn into an ancient temple courtyard at noon.

perfumes.name: Jubilation Man 40
perfumes.description: Dark blackberry and cassis spill over frankincense, opoponax and cinnamon-dusted bay leaf, a royal feast laid out in a candlelit Omani fort. Oud, patchouli and myrrh deepen the finish into resinous, fruit-stained wood that grows richer by the hour.

perfumes.name: Line 618
perfumes.description: Creamy coconut milk and frankincense smoke drift over pine needles and a slice of pineapple, sunlit resin on a tropical temple trail. Sandalwood and soft leather settle it into a warm, milky woodiness that feels both exotic and comforting.

perfumes.name: Lustre
perfumes.description: Glowing myrrh and benzoin meet green cardamom and creamy sandalwood, polished amber resin catching candlelight in a dark wooden room. Vanilla, labdanum and a hint of orris give it a warm, burnished sheen that hugs the skin.

perfumes.name: Opus XII – Rose Incense
perfumes.description: Damask rose petals smoulder in olibanum smoke, with a stroke of ink and elemi for an almost liturgical edge. Myrrh, vanilla and sandalwood turn it into the warm, resinous air of a rose-strewn chapel.

perfumes.name: Outlands
perfumes.description: Frankincense, cardamom and a squeeze of lemon open over patchouli, anise and saffron, a caravan fire crackling under desert stars. Vanilla, amber and benzoin pull everything into a deep resinous warmth, threaded with a quiet line of oud.

perfumes.name: Reasons
perfumes.description: Palo santo and pine resin burn slowly beside cardamom, pink pepper and toasted hazelnut, a forest cabin scented with sacred wood. Myrrh, sandalwood and benzoin give it a calm, meditative warmth that settles deep into a wool sweater.

perfumes.name: Remain
perfumes.description: Rich vanilla and tonka bean melt over ylang-ylang and allspice, a mug of warm spiced milk beside a crackling fireplace. Frankincense, patchouli and guaiac wood keep the sweetness grown-up and leave a cozy amber trail.

perfumes.name: Sequence
perfumes.description: Tart raspberry and lychee are pressed into supple black leather, a red-lacquered jewelry box opened in a dim lounge. Rose, saffron and a smoky thread of oud give the fruit a dark, polished edge.

perfumes.name: Abed
perfumes.description: Tuberose, tiare flower and jasmine sambac bloom against salty iodine and warm stone, a flower garland drying on sun-baked rocks by the sea. Vanilla and a touch of myrrh give the white flowers a creamy, skin-warm finish.

perfumes.name: Aquatic Ozonic
perfumes.description: Salty sea spray crashes over pine needles and chamomile on a wind-whipped cliff path above the ocean. Cedar and a soft hint of vanilla dry it down into sun-bleached driftwood.

perfumes.name: Cérémonie
perfumes.description: Smoke and black leather wrap around a slice of caramelized pineapple, the afterglow of a bonfire ritual on a summer night. Olibanum, cedar and patchouli leave a dark, sweet, smouldering trail.

perfumes.name: Entre-Acte
perfumes.description: Honeyed immortelle and tuberose collide with rose and earthy patchouli, the heady air of a theatre dressing room during intermission. Leather, orange blossom and a powdery haze close the act with backstage glamour.

perfumes.name: Jardins Humanistes
perfumes.description: Lily of the valley, hyacinth and gardenia bloom in a green, dewy morning garden, stems still wet from the sprinklers. Mimosa and a touch of tuberose add soft, sunny petals to a fresh, airy floral.

perfumes.name: Narcotic Bohemic
perfumes.description: Buttery orris root meets cardamom, clove and a shot of black coffee in the smoky back room of a bohemian Paris café. Leather, tonka and tobacco wrap the iris in warm, earthy suede.

perfumes.name: Rock Rose
perfumes.description: Earthy patchouli and incense smoke rise from warm amber and labdanum, the resin-sticky air of a rockrose hillside under Mediterranean sun. Cedar and musk keep it dry, deep and quietly rock'n'roll.

perfumes.name: Sabrage
perfumes.description: Pear, passion fruit and cassis fizz open with champagne brightness over orange blossom, jasmine and tuberose, a rooftop celebration at golden hour. A soft cloud of musk, amber and sandalwood keeps the sparkle glowing on skin.

perfumes.name: Sahara 4800
perfumes.description: Sun-scorched sand, saffron and nutmeg meet supple leather and a splash of champagne at a desert expedition camp at dusk. Ink, cedar and patchouli give it a dry, mineral, adventurous edge.

perfumes.name: Shaman
perfumes.description: Smoky guaiac wood and raw leather crackle with black pepper, a ritual fire burning in a forest clearing. A cool touch of iris and magnolia adds a strange, powdery calm to the smoke.

perfumes.name: Oud Paradisio
perfumes.description: Juicy pineapple and a scoop of vanilla ice cream melt into saffron, incense and Bulgarian rose, an exotic dessert served in a palace garden. A deep, smoky oud base gives the sweetness a regal, resinous backbone.

perfumes.name: Silver Ceremony
perfumes.description: Sparkling Italian lemon, green mandarin and fresh ginger fizz over a clean thread of oud, a silver tray of iced citrus drinks in a marble lobby. Atlas cedar and labdanum give the brightness a smooth, woody polish.

perfumes.name: Stellar Silk
perfumes.description: Bourbon vanilla and melted butter swirl with orris and tonka bean, soft as a silk robe warmed by the fire. Creamy white sandalwood and a pinch of cinnamon give it a glowing, powdery finish.

perfumes.name: Vanille Caviar
perfumes.description: Dark vanilla pods and Peru balsam meet bitter cacao and labdanum, a luxurious dessert of black vanilla served in a candlelit salon. Calamus and osmanthus add an earthy, apricot-tinged depth to the resinous amber.

perfumes.name: Amber Intense
perfumes.description: A bold rose dusted with saffron and crisp apple glows over patchouli, cedar and guaiac wood. Vanilla, labdanum and sandalwood warm the petals into a rich, amber-tinted finish.

perfumes.name: Berlin Fever
perfumes.description: Tobacco leaf, cinnamon and nutmeg crackle with cardamom and ginger in a smoky Berlin bar at two in the morning. Vanilla, tonka and amber sweeten the haze into a warm, spiced trail.

perfumes.name: Berlin Heaven
perfumes.description: Crisp pear, lychee and raspberry tumble over dewy rose and lily of the valley, a bright Sunday brunch on a Berlin balcony. Soft musk, amber and woods keep the fruit light and airy.

perfumes.name: Berlin Soul
perfumes.description: Roasted hazelnut and a pour of smoky whiskey meet oud and tobacco leaf, a leather armchair in a late-night Kreuzberg bar. Cedar, sandalwood and iris smooth the edges into a soft, woody glow.

perfumes.name: Black Weed
perfumes.description: Saffron, coriander and cinnamon spark over sticky benzoin and nutmeg in a spice market lit by lanterns after dark. Musk, sandalwood and vanilla leave a smooth, leathery amber on skin.

perfumes.name: Charm Mystery
perfumes.description: Tangerine and lemon sparkle over jasmine and soft peach, then sink into a creamy cloud of vanilla and musk. Sweet, powdery and bright, it is a silk dress twirling at a summer garden party.

perfumes.name: Citrus Splash
perfumes.description: Sun-drenched bergamot and neroli splash over crisp cedar, an ice-cold lemonade on a terrace in July. Tea rose, freesia and musk keep it clean, sparkling and effortless.

perfumes.name: First Spring
perfumes.description: Apple blossom, juicy peach and lemon zest throw open the windows on the first warm day of the year. Freesia and jasmine float over a soft base of cedar, musk and sandalwood.

perfumes.name: Flora Femina
perfumes.description: Heady white lily and ripe apricot bloom with tangerine and stephanotis, a vase of lilies glowing in a sunny hallway. Musk and light amber give the petals a soft, powdery skin-warmth.

perfumes.name: Forest Fantasy
perfumes.description: Rosemary, lime and cool mint rush through lavender and green apple on a morning hike through a dew-soaked herb forest. Geranium, guaiac wood and pink pepper add a crisp, aromatic trail.

perfumes.name: Bordeaux Plaisir de la Nuit
perfumes.description: Warm cardamom and clary sage drift over patchouli, sandalwood and vanilla, an evening in a Bordeaux wine cellar lit by candles. A touch of apple, jasmine and rose softens the spice into velvet.

perfumes.name: Corsica Baiser de la Mer
perfumes.description: Sea salt, lime and crushed violet leaves sting the air of a rocky Corsican cove, with mint and lavender carried in from the maquis. Musk, moss and sandalwood dry down into sun-warmed skin after a swim.

perfumes.name: Grasse Fleur de Provence
perfumes.description: Violet petals and blackberry tangle with licorice and red thyme on a perfumer's workbench in Grasse, covered in flowers and herbs. Supple leather and vetiver give the bouquet a dark, earthy backbone.

perfumes.name: Paris Mon Amour
perfumes.description: Toasted sesame and pink pepper meet ylang-ylang, rose and orchid at a late supper on a Paris balcony at the blue hour. Warm amber and vanilla wrap it all in a sweet, powdery hug.

perfumes.name: Saint Tropez Éclat du Soleil
perfumes.description: Pink pepper, ginger and angelica flash with harbour sunlight in Saint-Tropez, while ambrette musk glows on salt-warmed skin. Olibanum, guaiac wood and sandalwood leave a smooth, ambery trail into the evening.

perfumes.name: Versailles Trésor de Jardin
perfumes.description: Lavender from the royal gardens meets bergamot, pink pepper and a dusting of cinnamon on a stroll along the clipped hedges of Versailles. Haitian vetiver and patchouli ground it in earthy, aristocratic elegance.

perfumes.name: Green Garden
perfumes.description: Fresh bamboo and freesia open onto wild rose and jasmine in a walled garden after a spring shower. Tuberose, musk and sandalwood add a creamy floral softness.

perfumes.name: Mornings in Milano
perfumes.description: Creamy coconut, vanilla and white peach melt into jasmine, plumeria and gardenia, a cappuccino and a sweet pastry at a sunlit Milan café. White musk keeps the sweetness soft and milky.

perfumes.name: Nights in Noto
perfumes.description: Saffron and fresh ginger glow over amber and jasmine on a warm Sicilian night among the honey-coloured baroque churches of Noto. White musk and sandalwood leave a soft, powdery trail.

perfumes.name: Portraits of Portofino
perfumes.description: Juicy mandarin, bergamot and lemon burst over magnolia, an aperitivo on the pastel waterfront of Portofino. Amber, soft woods and musk keep the sunshine on skin.

perfumes.name: Roads of Rome
perfumes.description: Resinous cypress lines an ancient Roman road, green and sun-warmed under a cloudless sky. A soft hint of white flowers keeps the aromatic woods fresh and elegant.

perfumes.name: Romance in Florence
perfumes.description: Golden saffron and cardamom melt into vanilla and tonka bean over a candlelit dinner above the Arno. Guaiac wood and white musk give the sweetness a smooth, smoky depth.

perfumes.name: Visions of Venice
perfumes.description: A bright rose with pineapple and apple floats over cedar and musk at a masked ball in a candlelit Venetian palazzo. Amber and violet add a powdery, romantic glow.

perfumes.name: Luxury Passion
perfumes.description: Watery notes and sweet anise ripple over mint, geranium and orange blossom, a cool breeze through the cabin of a sailing yacht. Creamy sandalwood and amber give it a smooth, woody finish.

perfumes.name: Ocean Hills
perfumes.description: Zesty lime and crisp green apple roll in with mint and pink pepper, a sea breeze over grassy coastal hills. Lavender, cedar, oakmoss and a touch of leather keep it clean and classic.

perfumes.name: Pacific Drive
perfumes.description: Sharp lemon and green leaves cut through sun-warmed cedar on a convertible drive along the Pacific coast. Orange blossom, magnolia and musk soften the dry woods into easy elegance.

perfumes.name: Secret Rendezvous
perfumes.description: Almond-soft heliotrope and orange blossom drift over a deep bed of musk, a secret meeting in a dim hotel corridor. Cedar, vetiver and patchouli give the powdery florals a mysterious, woody edge.

perfumes.name: Seductive Rose
perfumes.description: Black currant, ripe peach and tangerine burst over a velvety rose, red roses delivered with a box of fruit bonbons. Vanilla and patchouli give the sweetness a warm, flirtatious finish.

perfumes.name: Supreme Oud
perfumes.description: Pink pepper and cinnamon glow over warm amber, musk and smooth oud in an incense-scented majlis at nightfall. Patchouli and vetiver give it a dry, woody depth.

perfumes.name: Vanilla Vibes
perfumes.description: Fresh lavender and bergamot melt into creamy vanilla, a scoop of lavender-vanilla ice cream eaten in the shade. Soft amber and musk keep it cozy, powdery and easy to love.

perfumes.name: Velvet Orchid
perfumes.description: Velvety iris and orchid rest on a cushion of musk, amber and powdery notes, a vintage compact opened in a silk-lined boudoir. A touch of citrus and jasmine adds a soft glow.

perfumes.name: Wild Desires
perfumes.description: Crunchy green apple and bergamot meet cedar needles and a hint of cinnamon on an adventurous walk through a mountain forest. Cedar, vanilla and tonka bean give the freshness a warm, woody finish.

perfumes.name: Cedar N'Pepper
perfumes.description: Soft cashmere wood and white cedar are sprinkled with pink pepper, a minimalist Scandinavian interior on a crisp morning. Musk and amber make the woods feel smooth, clean and skin-close.

perfumes.name: Incense N'Fire
perfumes.description: Olibanum smoke rises from glowing labdanum resin and dark patchouli, a fire pit burning beneath a starry desert sky. Sandalwood and vanilla smooth the embers into warm, woody amber.

perfumes.name: Iris N'Wood
perfumes.description: Cool iris and cardamom drift over creamy sandalwood and cashmere wood, a tailored suit of soft grey flannel. Musk and a touch of cumin add a warm, skin-like elegance.

perfumes.name: Lady Cannabis
perfumes.description: Velvety apricot, rum and black pepper meet green tea, neroli and a hint of cannabis at a rebellious garden party at dusk. Supple leather, osmanthus and cashmere wood give it a smooth, daring finish.

perfumes.name: Royal Amber
perfumes.description: Lavender and cardamom meet a rich swirl of praline, a regal dessert served in a wood-panelled library. Sandalwood, patchouli and rose give the sweetness a warm, majestic depth.

perfumes.name: Sir Santal
perfumes.description: Creamy sandalwood and buttery orris root meet cardamom and soft leather, a gentleman's coat lined with silk. Benzoin, amber and musk give the woods a warm, powdery glow.

perfumes.name: 001 Orange Blossom, Petitgrain, Bergamot
perfumes.description: Neroli, orange blossom and petitgrain bloom over sparkling bergamot and citron, an orange grove at sunrise with dew still on the leaves. Rosemary, jasmine and a soft musk keep it crisp, clean and luminous.

perfumes.name: 003 Yuzu, Violet Leaves, Vetiver
perfumes.description: Tangy yuzu, bergamot and lime snap open over crisp violet leaves, a citrus stall in Kyoto after summer rain. Jasmine, neroli and vetiver dry down into a clean, green, airy finish.

perfumes.name: 101 Rose, Sweet Pea, White Cedar
perfumes.description: Turkish rose and sweet pea bloom with lily of the valley over pale white cedar, a ribbon-tied bouquet on a sunny windowsill. Lavender, cardamom and soft musk give it an airy, modern elegance.

perfumes.name: 103 Tiare Flower, Jasmine, Hibiscus
perfumes.description: Tiare flower, jasmine sambac and frangipani bloom in the warm air of a Polynesian lagoon, brightened by hibiscus and bergamot. Musk, vanilla and warm sand leave a creamy, sun-kissed trail.

perfumes.name: 104 Green Orange, Hyacinth, Ivy
perfumes.description: Galbanum, hyacinth and cool aquatic notes rise from wet earth, an old stone garden wall overgrown with ivy after the rain. Frankincense, amber and vetiver give the greenery a soft, resinous depth.

perfumes.name: 107 Nappa Tuberosa
perfumes.description: Creamy tuberose and ylang-ylang are wrapped in soft nappa suede, a pair of supple leather gloves resting on a bouquet of white flowers. Saffron, cashmeran and papyrus add a warm, woody, skin-like finish.

perfumes.name: 203 Raspberry, Vanilla, Blackberry
perfumes.description: Juicy raspberry, blackberry and pear spill over a scoop of vanilla, a summer fruit tart cooling on a sunny kitchen counter. Neroli, jasmine and soft woods keep the sweetness bright and airy.

perfumes.name: 204 Fig, Edamame, Ambrette
perfumes.description: Ripe fig and crisp violet leaves meet ambrette seeds and soft iris in a shaded Mediterranean courtyard where the fig trees hang heavy with fruit. Sandalwood and cedar wrap it in a velvety, powdery woodiness.

perfumes.name: 302 Amber, Iris, Sandalwood
perfumes.description: Golden amber and creamy sandalwood glow under a haze of incense and orris, a vinyl record spinning in a lamp-lit living room. Vanilla, cardamom and musk make it warm, powdery and irresistibly smooth.

perfumes.name: 303 Chili Pepper, Pink Berries, Benzoin
perfumes.description: Pink pepper and cardamom crackle over tolu balsam and benzoin, the glow of a fireplace on a winter night. Patchouli, ylang-ylang and amberwood leave a rich, spicy-sweet trail.

perfumes.name: 402 Vanilla, Caramel, Sandalwood
perfumes.description: Madagascar vanilla, golden caramel and spun sugar melt over almond blossom, a toffee shop window glowing on a winter night. Sandalwood, heliotrope and benzoin give the indulgence a soft, powdery finish.

perfumes.name: 403 Myrrh Shadow
perfumes.description: Dark myrrh and benzoin smoulder beneath bitter orange, timur pepper and basil, a shadowy chapel lit by a single candle. Vanilla, cedar and akigalawood give the resin a velvety, woody warmth.

perfumes.name: 502 Iris Cartagena
perfumes.description: Dark cocoa and a splash of rum meet powdery iris and mandarin in a colonial café in Cartagena at dusk. Coffee, sandalwood and vetiver give it a rich, woody, slightly bitter warmth.

perfumes.name: 502 Iris Cartagena Extrait
perfumes.description: Rich cocoa and roasted coffee are folded into buttery iris and creamy sandalwood, an old Cartagena chocolate house with powder-blue walls. Rum, papyrus and sugar cane give this extrait a deeper, woodier intensity.

perfumes.name: 602 Pepper, Cedar, Patchouli
perfumes.description: Cracked black pepper and bay leaf meet dry cedar and incense smoke, a woodshed beside a mountain chalet. Vetiver, patchouli and a touch of neroli add an earthy, resinous depth.

perfumes.name: 602 Bois Narcotique Intense
perfumes.description: Frankincense and three kinds of pepper burn over crisp apple and neroli, a bonfire in a cedar forest on an autumn night. Cedar, vetiver, moss and amber make this extrait deeper, earthier and more resinous.

perfumes.name: 603 Leather, Incense, Tonka Bean
perfumes.description: Nutmeg and violet leaf open onto labdanum, clary sage and smooth leather, an old travel trunk lined with soft suede. Tonka bean, cashmeran and nagarmotha leave a warm, ambery, woody trail.

perfumes.name: 801 Sea Spray, Cedar, Grapefruit
perfumes.description: Sea spray, grapefruit and rosemary blow in off the coast on a windy morning along a Mediterranean seafront. Cypress, cedar and white musk dry it into salty, sunlit woods.

perfumes.name: 901 Nutmeg, Almond, Patchouli
perfumes.description: Ginger, black pepper and nutmeg spark over blond woods and toasted almond, a well-cut jacket for an evening out. Tonka bean, patchouli and musk melt the spice into a warm, creamy trail.

perfumes.name: 903 Nepal Berries, Saffron, Oud
perfumes.description: Saffron and Sichuan pepper flare over dark patchouli and smoky oud, a caravanserai deep in the Zagros mountains. Sandalwood, iris and musk soften the spice into a smooth, earthy woodiness.

perfumes.name: À Cœur Perdu L.B.
perfumes.description: Orange blossom and neroli glow over cool iris and a flash of aldehydes, a love letter sealed with wax and left on a sunny windowsill. Bergamot, cashmeran and moss give it a clean, powdery tenderness.

perfumes.name: Acte d'Amour Furtif A.N.
perfumes.description: Black pepper and warm cumin flare over powdery iris, a stolen moment in the shadow of a Paris doorway. Virginia cedar and amberwood leave a dry, skin-warm woodiness.

perfumes.name: C'est Toujours Agréable d'Être Attendu O.W.
perfumes.description: Bright bergamot and bitter orange with a twist of ginger, the joy of spotting someone waiting for you at the station. Soft musk, amber and woods keep the citrus warm and close.
perfumes.shopNames: O.W. C’est Toujours Agreable d’Etre Attendu

perfumes.name: Dandy or Not G.A.
perfumes.description: Smoky black tea and cardamom meet polished leather and grapefruit, a dandy's afternoon in a wood-panelled Paris club. Orange blossom, cedar and patchouli add a refined, slightly rebellious elegance.

perfumes.name: Il N'y a Pas de Bien Ni de Mal T.J.
perfumes.description: Golden resins and labdanum smoulder with incense and smoke in a dim chapel where good and evil blur together. Oud, vanilla and patchouli give it a deep, ambery sweetness.
perfumes.shopNames: T.J. Il N’y a Pas De Bien Ni De Mal

perfumes.name: J'ai l'Air de Ce Que Je Suis J.R.
perfumes.description: Velvety iris and lilac bloom over cardamom and clementine, a confident stroll down a Paris boulevard in springtime. Narcissus, musk and sandalwood leave a powdery, self-assured trail.
perfumes.shopNames: J.R. J’ai L’air De Ce Que Je Suis

perfumes.name: J'approchais un Mystère A.C.
perfumes.description: Atlas and Virginia cedar meet green fig leaf and creamy sandalwood on a quiet walk into a misty forest where something mysterious waits. A dash of pink pepper keeps the woods bright.

perfumes.name: Je Suis le Plus Grand M.A.
perfumes.description: A radiant cloud of ambroxan, Iso E Super and white musk, clean skin glowing with confidence. Angelica, iris and violet add a soft, powdery shimmer to the woods.
perfumes.shopNames: M.A. Je Suis Le Plus Grand

perfumes.name: Jusqu'à Toi P.S.
perfumes.description: Geranium and rosy grapefruit sparkle with pink pepper, a postscript scribbled at the bottom of a love letter. Magnolia, cypress and Haitian vetiver dry it into fresh, earthy woods.

perfumes.name: Les Ombres Fantastiques A.R.
perfumes.description: Cardamom and bergamot flicker over cool iris, strange shadows thrown on a wall by candlelight. Haitian vetiver, cedar and white musk ground it in earthy, powdery woods.

perfumes.name: Nous Sommes Amants M.D.
perfumes.description: Palo santo and juniper berries crackle over sandalwood and cedar, two lovers sharing a blanket by a woodland fire. Bamboo, pepper and a touch of leather keep the woods fresh and intimate.

perfumes.name: Quelque Chose dans l'Air S.C.
perfumes.description: Magnolia, lily and juicy yellow fruits drift over soft leather, a feeling in the air that something is about to happen. Mandarin, arnica, musk and sandalwood add a bright, animalic glow.

perfumes.name: Songe à la Douceur C.B.
perfumes.description: Carrot seed and grapefruit open onto silky magnolia, a soft daydream on a lazy Sunday morning. Vetiver and white musk give it a powdery, earthy tenderness.

perfumes.name: Sur Tes Lèvres E.Q.
perfumes.description: Buttery iris and pink pepper meet soft cashmeran, the trace of a kiss on warm skin. Jasmine, amber and patchouli give it a creamy, powdery, irresistibly close finish.

perfumes.name: Te Dire Oui V.H.
perfumes.description: Saffron, pink and black pepper spark over supple leather and Damask rose in the moment before saying yes. Incense, styrax and benzoin wrap it in a smoky, ambery warmth.

perfumes.name: Une Rose au Paradis R.B.
perfumes.description: Sparkling aldehydes lift Turkish rose and freesia into a soft, cloudlike musk, a rose petal floating in a sunlit sky. Cashmeran, sandalwood and a hint of incense keep it gentle and luminous.

perfumes.name: Vouloir Être Ailleurs C.G.
perfumes.description: Honeyed linden blossom and acacia drift over sun-dried hay and beeswax, a daydream of escaping to a meadow in June. Angelica and lemon leaf keep the sweetness green and fresh.

perfumes.name: Eau Duelle edp
perfumes.description: Bourbon vanilla is wrapped in wisps of incense, cardamom and pink pepper, a spice caravan resting in the desert at dusk. Nagarmotha gives the creamy vanilla a dry, smoky, resinous edge.

perfumes.name: Philosykos edt
perfumes.description: Crushed fig leaves, green sap and sun-warmed fig wood, a lazy afternoon under a fig tree on a Greek hillside. Lighter and fresher than the eau de parfum, with a milky trace of ripe fruit.

perfumes.name: Blue Talisman Extrait de Parfum
perfumes.description: Juicy pear and bergamot glow over orange blossom and jasmine, the talisman's bright energy turned up to extrait strength. Amberwood, sandalwood, vanilla and musk give it a smoother, warmer trail.

perfumes.name: Lust in Paradise Extrait de Parfum
perfumes.description: Dewy rose and juicy blackcurrant burst with pink pepper and ginger, a pink sunset over a tropical garden. Jasmine sambac, musk and akigalawood make the extrait richer, rosier and longer-lasting.

perfumes.name: Musc Ravageur
perfumes.description: Cinnamon and clove burn over lavender and tangerine, then sink into a warm, animal-soft musk with vanilla and tonka bean. It is skin after a long night out, spiced, powdery and unapologetically magnetic.

perfumes.name: Angel Dust
perfumes.description: Soft cashmeran and cashmere musk wrap around a pinch of pepper and bergamot, a freshly washed cashmere sweater pulled over warm skin. White amber gives the cloud a smooth, cosy glow.

perfumes.name: Angel Dust Extrait
perfumes.description: Pink pepper sparkles over cashmere wood and cashmeran, the softest blanket on a cold morning. At extrait strength the white amber and woods glow deeper and stay on skin all day.

perfumes.name: Borntostandout
perfumes.description: A peppery rose blooms over geranium and bergamot, then darkens with cedar, tobacco and soft leather, a rock star's dressing room after the encore. Akigalawood and amber give it a bold, smoky, unforgettable trail.

perfumes.name: Cash Flower
perfumes.description: A flood of fresh rose petals with a crack of pepper, a bouquet bought on impulse on the way to a celebration. Cashmere wood, musk and amber make the rose soft, modern and easy to wear.

perfumes.name: Goudh
perfumes.description: Smoky agarwood meets Bulgarian rose, leather and a burst of grapefruit, a gilded oud ritual in a modern Amsterdam loft. Black currant, patchouli and benzoin add depth to the animalic woods.

perfumes.name: In Love With The Cocos
perfumes.description: Cool coconut water and lemon zest splash over orange blossom and geranium, a fresh coconut sipped through a straw on a white-sand beach. Soft musk and amber keep it airy and sunlit.

perfumes.name: NoCologne
perfumes.description: Pink grapefruit, mandarin, bergamot and lemon fizz with fresh ginger, a cologne that refuses to play by the old rules. Clary sage, mimosa, ambrette and oakmoss give the citrus a smooth, modern finish.

perfumes.name: Orange Crush
perfumes.description: Juicy, sparkling orange bursts with soda-pop brightness over Iso E Super and white amber. It is the first sip of an ice-cold orange drink on a scorching afternoon.

perfumes.name: Orange Crush Extrait
perfumes.description: Freshly squeezed orange, bergamot and a hint of blackcurrant burst over Iso E Super and white amber, a basket of oranges in a sunny market. Akigalawood, musk and oakmoss give the extrait a longer, woodier glow.

perfumes.name: Fugazzi Parfum
perfumes.description: Tart black currant, mandarin and peppermint open over davana, frankincense and pink pepper, the signature that started the Amsterdam house. Patchouli, cedar and sandalwood give it a green, woody depth.

perfumes.name: Passionfroudh
perfumes.description: Ripe passion fruit and mango meet black tea and ginger, a tropical cocktail served in an oud-scented lounge. Smoky agarwood and cypriol turn the juicy fruit dark, woody and addictive.

perfumes.name: Pomegranoudh
perfumes.description: Glossy pomegranate seeds and red berries burst over a smoky core of oud, jewel-red fruit piled in a dark wooden bowl. Patchouli, amber and vanilla give the tart fruit a warm, resinous finish.

perfumes.name: Sugardaddy
perfumes.description: Juicy tangerine and black currant collide with clove and nutmeg at a cocktail party where the drinks are on someone else. Cashmeran, ambergris and patchouli give the spice a polished, expensive glow.

perfumes.name: Vanilla Haze
perfumes.description: Vanilla pods, toasted hazelnut and almond melt into coconut milk and golden caramel, a warm bakery filling the street with sugar-scented air. Tonka bean, musk and cashmere wood keep it soft and cosy.

perfumes.name: Vanilla Haze Extrait
perfumes.description: Bourbon vanilla is warmed with saffron and clove, then folded into hazelnut, coconut milk and caramel. The extrait is spicier and deeper, a vanilla haze glowing at golden hour.

perfumes.name: Almafolia
perfumes.description: Lush tuberose, ylang-ylang and jasmine bloom over peach and sweet orange, a Tuscan villa garden heavy with flowers at dusk. Coconut, vanilla and benzoin give it a creamy, sun-warmed sweetness.

perfumes.name: Bianco Latte
perfumes.description: Warm caramel, honey and vanilla swirl into a cup of sweet, milky latte, a cosy café corner on a rainy afternoon. White musk keeps the gourmand cloud soft, creamy and comforting.

perfumes.name: Bianco Oro
perfumes.description: Pink and black pepper glitter over creamy Javanol sandalwood and a soft rose, white gold catching the light. Cetalox amber and patchouli leave a clean, warm, woody trail.

perfumes.name: Blu Indaco
perfumes.description: Sweet almond and frangipani float over bergamot and a cloud of musk, a swim in an indigo sea followed by almond biscotti. Vanilla and ambroxan give it a soft, powdery, sun-warmed finish.

perfumes.name: Blu Mare
perfumes.description: Salty sea notes and cypress sweep over bergamot, grapefruit and pink pepper, a sailboat leaving a Tuscan harbour at dawn. Oakmoss and ambergris give it a deep, mineral, classic freshness.

perfumes.name: Borabora
perfumes.description: Tiare flower, ylang-ylang and jasmine bloom over creamy coconut milk, a flower crown worn on a Polynesian beach at sunset. Vanilla, caramel and white musk make it sweet, soft and holiday-warm.

perfumes.name: Celeste
perfumes.description: Sugared violets and raspberry drift over a breath of sea water, a pastel sky above the Tuscan coast. Vanilla sugar and ambroxan make it powdery, sweet and dreamy.

perfumes.name: Christos
perfumes.description: Clouds of incense rise over amber and labdanum, an ancient Tuscan church on a winter morning. Sandalwood, benzoin, patchouli and vanilla give the smoke a warm, resinous softness.

perfumes.name: Colonia Nobile
perfumes.description: Bergamot, petitgrain and neroli sparkle in a classic noble cologne, freshly ironed linen in a Florentine palazzo. Jasmine, benzoin and oakmoss give it an elegant, lasting finish.

perfumes.name: Rosso Radice
perfumes.description: Pink pepper and clary sage spark over earthy vetiver roots and soft cashmeran, red Tuscan soil after a summer storm. Ambroxan and ambrette musk leave a warm, clean, woody trail.

perfumes.name: Rosso Rubino
perfumes.description: Bergamot, orange and lemon open onto cacao pod and wild berries, a ruby-red sunset over a mossy Tuscan forest. Oakmoss, pink pepper, cashmeran and patchouli give it a rich, modern chypre depth.

perfumes.name: Scintilla
perfumes.description: Pineapple, apple and black currant sparkle over a radiant cloud of Iso E Super, a spark of light on polished wood. Iris, violet, oakmoss and amber give the fruit a smooth, powdery, woody glow.

perfumes.name: Shabby Chic
perfumes.description: Fresh peony and Bulgarian rose bloom in a vintage enamel jug on a whitewashed table, all lace curtains and soft light. Musk, Javanol and cedar give the petals a clean, powdery finish.

perfumes.name: Can't Get Enough
perfumes.description: A plush Turkish rose dipped in golden caramel and vanilla, a box of rose chocolates opened far too quickly. Hedione, tonka and pink pepper keep the sweetness bright and addictive.

perfumes.name: Lift Me Up
perfumes.description: Magnolia and bergamot float over creamy ylang-ylang and tonka, a sunny morning that starts with a smile. Vanilla and soft musk wrap the skin in a powdery, uplifting warmth.

perfumes.name: Sugar Blast
perfumes.description: Vanilla and praline explode in a sugar rush with a splash of rum and creamy coconut, a candy-store window at a seaside fair. Ambroxan and cashmeran keep the sweetness airy and radiant.

perfumes.name: Baie 19
perfumes.description: Rain falling on hot stone and green leaves, with crushed juniper berries in the air, the smell of a summer storm rolling in. Earthy patchouli, musk and ambroxan keep it cool, grey and quietly addictive.

perfumes.name: Fleur d'Oranger 27
perfumes.description: Pure orange blossom in full bloom, sharpened with petitgrain, bergamot and lemon, a whitewashed courtyard in Seville in April. Clean, luminous and sunny, it is a fresh white shirt worn on a warm day.

perfumes.name: Jasmin 17
perfumes.description: Jasmine and orange blossom bloom with bitter orange and neroli, a garden of white flowers glowing in late afternoon sun. Vanilla, musk and sandalwood give the brightness a soft, sheer warmth.

perfumes.name: Labdanum 18
perfumes.description: Warm labdanum resin melts into vanilla, musk and a purr of civet and castoreum, a cashmere throw beside the fire. Tonka, birch and cinnamon give it a powdery, animalic glow, the warmth of skin under soft wool.

perfumes.name: Neroli 36
perfumes.description: Orange blossom and sparkling aldehydes meet mandarin and jasmine, freshly laundered sheets drying in a Mediterranean breeze. Soft musk, vanilla and tonka leave a clean, glowing, slightly sweet trail.

perfumes.name: Ambre Supermassive
perfumes.description: Cinnamon, peach and apple are drenched in rum and honey, a spiced fruit compote bubbling on a winter stove. Amber, vanilla, tobacco and saffron give it a dense, glowing, supermassive warmth.

perfumes.name: Plumeria Supercritique
perfumes.description: Almond, red berries and heliotrope melt into creamy iris and plumeria, a frangipani garden at dusk with marzipan on the breeze. Tonka bean and black vanilla husk give it a sweet, powdery, gourmand depth.

perfumes.name: Superose
perfumes.description: A radiant rose bursts with peach, pear and lychee, then glows with saffron and mandarin, a supernova of petals. Patchouli, white musk and vanilla give it a warm, modern finish.

perfumes.name: Aldebaran
perfumes.description: A bold, green tuberose spiced with smoky paprika and maté, the brightest star burning in a night sky. Tonka bean softens the edges into a modern, genderless white floral.

perfumes.name: Metal Lavender
perfumes.description: Two lavenders, cultivated and wild, are polished to a cool metallic sheen, a lavender field glinting under a silver morning sky. Musk and cashmeran turn it soft, powdery and modern.

perfumes.name: Vanilla Powder Extrait
perfumes.description: Pure vanilla absolute and coconut powder are concentrated into a velvety extrait, warm sand on sun-kissed skin. Tonka bean, white musk and palo santo make it creamier, deeper and longer-lasting than the original.

perfumes.name: Ithaque
perfumes.description: Bergamot, bitter orange and three peppers burst over currant buds, red currant and juniper, a sailboat gliding into the harbour of Ithaca. Texas cedar and patchouli give the brightness a dry, woody wake.

perfumes.name: Odéon
perfumes.description: A velvety rose and spoonfuls of rose jam glow under the lights of a Paris theatre on opening night. Sandalwood, tonka, amber and musk wrap the petals in a warm, powdery, sweet finish.

perfumes.name: Zante
perfumes.description: Neroli, petitgrain and bergamot shimmer over rosemary and lavender, a sunlit terrace on the Greek island of Zakynthos. Amber and patchouli give the fresh citrus a soft, warm finish.

perfumes.name: Latte Pistachio
perfumes.description: Roasted pistachio and warm milk swirl with cardamom and coriander, a pistachio latte steaming in a Milan coffee bar. Creamy sandalwood, musk and amber keep it soft, nutty and cosy.
Glossy cherry, lychee and rose petals meet sweet almond and sugared violets, a box of marzipan cherries on a dressing table. Vanilla and sandalwood give it a soft, powdery, nostalgic finish.
Orange blossom, lemon and mandarin bask in 28-degree sunshine on a white villa terrace above the Mediterranean. Tuberose, jasmine, vanilla and immortelle add a warm, solar softness.

perfumes.name: Le Passant
perfumes.description: Fresh French lavender and marigold meet bergamot, a passer-by leaving a trail of clean warmth on a Paris street. Tonka bean, amyris and vanilla make it smooth, sweet and comforting.

perfumes.name: Les Brumes
perfumes.description: Fresh ginger and lemon cut through the morning mist, with sage and cardamom carried on a cool breeze over a quiet lake. Maté, cedar and vetiver keep it crisp, green and serene.

perfumes.name: L'Ivrée Bleue
perfumes.description: A splash of dark rum and cacao pod meet powdery iris and violet, a midnight-blue evening of chocolate and conversation. Vanilla, benzoin and patchouli give it a rich, velvety, tipsy warmth.

perfumes.name: Marque-Page
perfumes.description: Incense, davana and artemisia rise from the leather binding of an old book, a bookmark left between dusty pages in a candlelit library. Oud, nagarmotha, amber and patchouli give it a deep, smoky, woody warmth.

perfumes.name: Papier Carbone
perfumes.description: Star anise, coffee and cardamom sketch the outline of carbon paper and ink, a writer's desk in a sunny Paris apartment. Clary sage, ambrette, patchouli and guaiac wood fill in a warm, spicy, woody portrait.

perfumes.name: Tableau Parisien
perfumes.description: Opulent tuberose meets warm spices and blond tobacco, a Parisian painting of a woman lounging on a velvet sofa. Vanilla, tonka bean and benzoin give the flowers a creamy, sweet glow.

perfumes.name: Toi Toi Toi
perfumes.description: Incense and black pepper open onto sandalwood, cedar and patchouli, a good-luck wish before stepping on stage. Vanilla and nagarmotha make the woods smooth, smoky and comforting.

perfumes.name: Toi Toi Toi Extrait
perfumes.description: Frankincense and bitter orange flare over raspberry, osmanthus and supple leather in this richer extrait. Sandalwood, Atlas cedar and amber leave a warm, resinous, slightly fruity trail.

perfumes.name: Yvonne
perfumes.description: Black currant, juicy peach and marigold sparkle over rose and jasmine, a portrait of a spirited woman in a flowery dress. Patchouli, vanilla and tonka give it a warm chypre backbone.

perfumes.name: Yvonne Extrait
perfumes.description: Dark plum and Turkish rose melt into a deep bed of patchouli, Yvonne dressed for the evening. Peach, jasmine, tonka bean and amber give the extrait a rich, sweet glow.

perfumes.name: Althair
perfumes.description: Bourbon vanilla and praline are warmed with cinnamon, cardamom and orange blossom, a gentleman's dessert served by candlelight. Musk, ambroxan and guaiac wood give the sweetness a smooth, elegant finish.

perfumes.name: Carios
perfumes.description: Saffron, mandarin and pink pepper crackle over black pepper and geranium, a sharp suit worn to a late-night party. Ambroxan and tonka bean leave a radiant, ambery, spicy trail.

perfumes.name: Galloway
perfumes.description: Bright citrus and pepper open onto orange blossom and iris, the crisp elegance of a racing stable at dawn. Clean musk and amber give it a smooth, powdery finish.

perfumes.name: Palatine
perfumes.description: Sweet violet and juicy pear bloom over bergamot and lavender, a lilac silk scarf in a sunlit palace garden. Musk, sandalwood and vanilla give it a soft, powdery, graceful finish.

perfumes.name: Valaya Exclusif
perfumes.description: Sweet almond and mandarin float over orange blossom and soft powder, a white silk gown at a summer soirée. Vanilla, sandalwood, ambroxan and white musk give the Exclusif a creamier, richer trail than Valaya.

perfumes.name: Valero
perfumes.description: Citron, bergamot and juniper sparkle over lavender, geranium and nutmeg, a classic barbershop ritual reinvented as an extrait. Ambrox, patchouli and sandalwood give it a clean, ambery, woody depth.

perfumes.name: Azure Blush
perfumes.description: Fluffy pink peony and juicy lychee with a tart snap of rhubarb, a blush-pink sky over a calm blue sea. Simple, fresh and joyful, it is a bouquet held up to the morning sun.

perfumes.name: Blond Purple
perfumes.description: Dark, juicy black currant meets ripe mango and a touch of ylang-ylang, a purple sorbet melting in the summer sun. Playful, fruity and sweet, with a soft woody base.

perfumes.name: Blue Forest
perfumes.description: Crisp cedar and a crack of pepper, a walk through a blue-green forest on a cold, clear morning. Soft musk keeps the woods clean and close to the skin.

perfumes.name: Gold Fawn
perfumes.description: Golden vanilla melts into creamy sandalwood and a touch of cedar, sunlight on a fawn's soft coat in an autumn wood. Warm, powdery and comforting.

perfumes.name: Ivory Sky
perfumes.description: Earthy vetiver and creamy sandalwood under a bright stroke of bergamot, an ivory-white sky over open fields. Clean, dry and effortlessly elegant.

perfumes.name: Mahogany Sun
perfumes.description: Creamy vanilla, ripe fig and frangipani glow in the late-afternoon sun of a tropical island. Sweet, milky and warm, it is suntanned skin at golden hour.

perfumes.name: Pink Fire
perfumes.description: Tart pomegranate and raspberry spark over a glowing bed of amberwood, pink flames flickering in a fireplace. Warm, woody and quietly radiant.

perfumes.name: Tangerine Pearl
perfumes.description: Juicy pomelo and zesty ginger sparkle over a soft pearl of iris, a glass of fresh citrus juice on a bright morning. Clean, lively and easy to wear.

perfumes.name: Cherry Punk
perfumes.description: Black cherry and saffron crash into a black leather jacket at a punk gig in a sweaty basement club. Tonka bean, violet and patchouli give the rebellion a sweet, smoky edge.

perfumes.name: Cherry Punk Extrait
perfumes.description: Juicy cherry and Sichuan pepper meet black leather in a louder, deeper extrait, the encore of the punk show. Saffron, tonka and patchouli keep it sweet, spiky and long-lasting.

perfumes.name: Electric Wood
perfumes.description: Crackling cedar and oak glow with ambroxan and warm resins, an electric guitar case lined with velvet. Iris and nutmeg add a dry, powdery hum to the woods.

perfumes.name: Holly Rose
perfumes.description: A dark rose and black currant are thrown against cracked leather and black pepper in a rock-and-roll hotel room in Hollywood. Patchouli gives the rose a dirty, glamorous edge.

perfumes.name: Jasmine Freak
perfumes.description: Egyptian jasmine and Indian tuberose explode with juicy mango and sweet orange, a wild night at a flower market in full bloom. Ylang-ylang, musk and cashmere wood make it creamy, fruity and unapologetic.

perfumes.name: Love-O-Matic
perfumes.description: Strawberry and bubble gum float in a cloud of ozonic notes and soft musk, a vintage photo booth on a pastel boardwalk. Ambrette and cedar keep the sweetness airy and skin-close.

perfumes.name: Purple Mantra
perfumes.description: Incense and myrrh drift over lavender, clary sage and iris, a meditation room glowing in purple light. Ambroxan and musk give the smoke a calm, resinous warmth.

perfumes.name: Sonic Flower
perfumes.description: Buttery orris and carrot seed hum over soft musk, the quiet feedback of a guitar amp in a pastel studio. Ambroxan and cashmeran give the powdery iris a warm, skin-like glow.

perfumes.name: Sweet Leaf
perfumes.description: Green cannabis leaves and cool eucalyptus meet grapefruit and angelica, a hazy studio session in 1970s California. Musk and woods give the herbal haze a smooth, smoky finish.

perfumes.name: Ten Fifteen
perfumes.description: Creamy sandalwood and violet glow with saffron and mandarin, the signature of a legendary hotel room where rock stars once stayed. Guaiac wood and papyrus give it a dry, powdery, effortlessly cool finish.

perfumes.name: Wave Child
perfumes.description: Juicy watermelon and creamy coconut ride an ozonic wave, a surf session at sunset with salt drying on the skin. Mandarin, ambergris and a touch of cacao keep it sunny, sweet and carefree.

perfumes.name: Yesterday
perfumes.description: Cardamom, thyme and bergamot open onto lavender and geranium, a vintage barbershop on a Sunday morning in the sixties. Vetiver, sandalwood and white musk leave a clean, nostalgic trail.
Thyme and myrrh smoulder over yellow mandarin and nutmeg, a lucky number scrawled in smoke. White musk, cashmeran, ambroxan and oud leave a warm, woody, magnetic trail.

perfumes.name: Gladiator
perfumes.description: Pineapple, green apple and peppermint charge in with lemon and grapefruit, a gladiator's victory lap under a blazing sun. Vetiver, cedar and patchouli give the freshness a strong, woody backbone.

perfumes.name: Gladiator Extrait
perfumes.description: Icy peppermint, green apple and grapefruit clash with pineapple and bitter orange in the original, more intense extrait. Cedar, vetiver and patchouli leaf keep it sharp, green and powerful.

perfumes.name: Greasque
perfumes.description: Clary sage, peppermint and galbanum rush over basil and clove, a wild herb garden on a Greek hillside. Cedar, caramel and violet add a soft, unexpected sweetness.

perfumes.name: Greasque Extrait
perfumes.description: Sweet basil and peppermint lead a burst of green herbs and currant buds, a Mediterranean kitchen garden at noon. Galbanum, vetiver and cedar make the extrait deeper and greener.

perfumes.name: Jany
perfumes.description: Baked apple, flaky puff pastry and Ceylon cinnamon, a warm apple strudel straight from a Viennese oven. Vanilla, caramel, almond and nuts make it irresistibly sweet and cosy.

perfumes.name: Red
perfumes.description: Roasted hazelnut, cardamom and coconut meet fig, clementine and nutmeg, a red velvet box of spiced pralines. Caramel, sandalwood and musk give it a warm, sweet, woody finish.

perfumes.name: Mallow
perfumes.description: The fluffy sweetness of raspberry, vanilla sugar and heliotrope, a pink marshmallow cloud. Violet and black musk give it a soft, powdery, grown-up finish.

perfumes.name: Mandorle
perfumes.description: Tonka bean, sweet almond and heliotrope melt into vanilla and soft suede, almond biscotti beside a cup of hot chocolate. Cashmere wood, rum and caramel make it warm and comforting.

perfumes.name: Mandorle Extrait
perfumes.description: Soft suede soaked in rum meets tonka bean, vanilla and almond in the richer, original extrait. Heliotrope, caramel and cashmere wood give it a velvety, gourmand depth.

perfumes.name: Orchidée Rouge
perfumes.description: Dark rum and orange are spiced with cinnamon and swirled into almond milk and heliotrope, a red orchid cocktail served at sunset. Caramel, vanilla and benzoin give it a sweet, festive finish.

perfumes.name: Orchidée Rouge Extrait
perfumes.description: Vanilla absolute, caramel and almond milk swirl with rum and heliotrope in the creamier original extrait. Bergamot, cinnamon and benzoin give it a warm, glowing sweetness.

perfumes.name: Ylop
perfumes.description: Velvety apricot and osmanthus meet green tea and crisp apple, a sunny tea house in a blossoming orchard. Toasted sesame, almond and vanilla add a creamy, nutty softness.

perfumes.name: Acamar
perfumes.description: A luminous rose with bergamot and violet rests on a soft cushion of musk and patchouli, a royal garden at twilight. Amber gives it a warm, powdery, chypre-like elegance.

perfumes.name: Affinity
perfumes.description: Warm nutmeg and bergamot open onto lavender and geranium, a gentleman's study with a crackling fire. Moss, amber, sandalwood and olibanum leave a classic, mossy, woody trail.

perfumes.name: Allegiance
perfumes.description: A noble rose and magnolia rise over juniper and bergamot, a vow of loyalty sworn in a royal court. Olibanum, vetiver, cedar and musk give the flowers a smoky, woody, ambery strength.

perfumes.name: Altair
perfumes.description: Black truffle, black currant and ylang-ylang meet warm spices, an earthy feast in a candlelit hall. Patchouli, amber, vanilla and vetiver give it a rich, dark, opulent depth.

perfumes.name: Aludra
perfumes.description: Turkish rose and peony bloom with juicy lychee and rhubarb, a bouquet of pink flowers in a sunlit palace. Vanilla, musk, cashmeran and a touch of incense keep it fresh and radiant.

perfumes.name: Amity
perfumes.description: Juicy strawberry, raspberry and pineapple glow with saffron and orris, a basket of summer berries at a royal picnic. Benzoin, moss, amber and vanilla give the fruit a warm, sweet, resinous base.

perfumes.name: Arrakis
perfumes.description: A blast of sparkling grapefruit over ambroxan and dry woods, the sun rising over endless desert dunes. Clean, bright and magnetic, it stays fresh all day.

perfumes.name: Dedication
perfumes.description: Raspberry, saffron and ylang-ylang meet a lush Moroccan rose, a gift of devotion wrapped in red silk. Labdanum, Cambodian oud and sandalwood give it a deep, sweet, regal finish.

perfumes.name: Elevation
perfumes.description: Black pepper, cypress and lemon rush up a mountain path, with sage and orris in the cool air. Vetiver, sandalwood and soft leather give it a dry, elevated woodiness.

perfumes.name: Errai
perfumes.description: Velvety iris and rose with a hint of lemon float over green notes and passion fruit, a cool morning in a royal orangery. Musk, vanilla and amber leave a soft, powdery, elegant trail.

perfumes.name: Fidelity
perfumes.description: A deep rose and dark patchouli intertwine with sweet vanilla, a promise of faithfulness sealed with red wax. Agarwood, benzoin and amber give it a smoky, resinous richness.

perfumes.name: Hadar
perfumes.description: Sugared rose petals and lemon melt into creamy vanilla and white musk, a rose macaron on a silver plate. Soft, sweet and powdery, with a light watery freshness.

perfumes.name: Harmony
perfumes.description: Passion fruit, pineapple and bergamot burst over rose and violet leaves, a tropical sunrise over a calm lagoon. Musk, vanilla, moss and soft woods keep it balanced, sweet and fresh.

perfumes.name: Honor
perfumes.description: Saffron and clove glow over ripe fig and rose, then dissolve into incense smoke and agarwood, an honour guard in a torch-lit palace hall. Amber gives the oud a warm, regal finish.

perfumes.name: Intuition
perfumes.description: Saffron, cardamom and ginger crackle over violet leaves, then sink into Cambodian oud and vanilla, a gut feeling in a dark, resinous room. Castoreum and benzoin add a leathery, animalic depth.

perfumes.name: Kursa
perfumes.description: A bold rose and mandarin bloom over musk and patchouli in classic Middle Eastern rose-oud style. Rich agarwood and labdanum give the petals a smoky, majestic finish.

perfumes.name: Loyalty
perfumes.description: Dark rum and saffron warm a glass beside a crackling fire, a toast to old friendships. Labdanum, oud, patchouli and vanilla wrap it in a smooth, boozy, woody warmth.

perfumes.name: Matar
perfumes.description: Juicy pineapple, black currant and apple meet smoky birch and patchouli, a victory celebration in an ancient stone fortress. Oakmoss, ambergris and musk give it a classic, confident, smoky-fruity trail.

perfumes.name: Mercy
perfumes.description: Golden amber and warm caramel melt together, a honey-coloured glow in a quiet royal chapel. Musk, vanilla, moss and ambergris give it a soft, powdery, comforting sweetness.

perfumes.name: Nobility
perfumes.description: Watery notes and juicy pineapple sparkle with lavender, plum and saffron, a royal yacht cutting through blue water. Heliotrope, immortelle, musk and sandalwood leave a smooth, sweet freshness.

perfumes.name: Notion
perfumes.description: Eucalyptus, saffron and lime brighten a heart of orris and Bulgarian rose, an idea taking shape in a quiet study. Earthy patchouli and Haitian vetiver give it a powdery, woody depth.

perfumes.name: Perception
perfumes.description: Smoky birch, cognac and tart rhubarb meet ylang-ylang and orris, a hunting lodge with a decanter on the table. Thyme, rosemary and soft leather give it an aromatic, woody sophistication.

perfumes.name: Sagira
perfumes.description: Sparkling grapefruit and peach brighten a Damask rose and violet, a little star shining in the evening sky. Patchouli, musk and moss give it a soft chypre finish with a hint of toffee.

perfumes.name: Tabana
perfumes.description: Agarwood, saffron and cardamom smoulder over rich black leather, a falconer's saddle in a desert camp. Pepper and ambergris give it a bold, animalic, spicy power.

perfumes.name: Verity
perfumes.description: Juicy pineapple and bergamot sparkle with aldehydes, the plain truth of a sunny morning. Leather, jasmine, patchouli and oakmoss give the fruit a confident, chypre-like depth.

perfumes.name: Virtue
perfumes.description: Nutmeg, lavender and marigold open onto jasmine and white woods, a noble character in a sunlit cloister. Patchouli, vetiver, olibanum and brown sugar give it a warm, woody, slightly sweet finish.

perfumes.name: Zaurac
perfumes.description: Green cardamom and Sichuan pepper spark over smoky agarwood, a spice caravan at the edge of the desert. Tonka bean, sandalwood, amber and vanilla smooth the oud into a warm, sweet trail.

perfumes.name: Black Gemstone
perfumes.description: Dark resins and myrrh glow inside a black gemstone, the hush of a desert temple at night. Teak wood, olibanum and tonka give it a deep, smoky, ambery richness.

perfumes.name: Crying of Evil
perfumes.description: Spices and red berries meet a dark heart of leather and sandalwood, the cry of a villain echoing through a gothic hall. Amber, olibanum and patchouli give it a smoky, animalic depth.

perfumes.name: God of Fire
perfumes.description: Juicy mango bursts with lemon, ginger and red berries, a blazing sunset over a tropical volcano. Musk, oud, amber and nagarmotha give the fire a smooth, woody glow.

perfumes.name: Isra & Miraj
perfumes.description: Nutmeg, cinnamon and mandarin open onto heliotrope and osmanthus, a night flight across a starlit desert sky. Vanilla, ambergris, sandalwood and a touch of oud leave a powdery, ambery warmth.

perfumes.name: Khôl de Bahreïn
perfumes.description: Sweet resins and violet melt into buttery iris and ambergris, kohl-lined eyes glinting in a Bahraini souk. Peru balsam and sandalwood give it a warm, powdery, velvety glow.

perfumes.name: Lady White Snake
perfumes.description: Tuberose, orange blossom and honeysuckle coil around soft white leather, the Chinese legend of a white serpent in a moonlit garden. Magnolia, jasmine and white musk keep it creamy and hypnotic.

perfumes.name: Le 8
perfumes.description: Hibiscus, yuzu and fragrant tea blossom with cherry flowers and strawberry, a lucky number eight painted in red on a paper lantern. Sandalwood, tonka, vanilla and saffron give it a soft, warm finish.

perfumes.name: Mortal Skin
perfumes.description: Black ink and blackberry stain the skin over incense and myrrh, a tattoo needle buzzing in a candlelit studio. Opoponax, iris, styrax and cedar give it a dark, resinous, smoky depth.

perfumes.name: O Hira
perfumes.description: Rare, pure ambergris washed ashore on a remote beach, salty, warm and gently animalic. It glows golden and skin-like, growing richer the longer you wear it.

perfumes.name: Oumma
perfumes.description: Three roses from Morocco, Bulgaria and Grasse bloom over rich tolu and Peru balsams, a mother's warm hug in a rose-scented home. Smoky agarwood and nagarmotha give it a deep, resinous, regal finish.

perfumes.name: Panthéa
perfumes.description: Tangerine and bergamot brighten a heart of iris, jasmine and violet, a marble goddess in a sunlit temple. White musk, sandalwood and tonka give it a clean, powdery serenity.

perfumes.name: Panthéa Iris
perfumes.description: Iris in its purest, most velvety form, wrapped in violet and a hint of tangerine. White musk, tonka bean, tobacco and sandalwood make it powdery, soft and elegant.

perfumes.name: Pink Boa
perfumes.description: Raspberry, blackberry and strawberry are shaken with vodka and basil, a pink feather boa twirling at a cabaret party. Musk, peach and sandalwood keep the fun sweet and lively.

perfumes.name: Rose de Petra
perfumes.description: A dewy rose and lychee bloom against warm cardamom, pepper and cumin, the rose-red cliffs of Petra at sunrise. Spicy, fresh and fiery, it is a rose with a desert soul.

perfumes.name: Sand Dance
perfumes.description: A splash of whiskey and dark cacao swirl over creamy sandalwood, dunes shifting under a golden desert moon. Tonka, benzoin, styrax and vanilla give it a smooth, warm, gourmand finish.

perfumes.name: Sea My Love
perfumes.description: Salty sea air and marine notes meet supple leather, a love letter written on the deck of a sailboat. Mandarin, jasmine, amber and benzoin give the ocean breeze a warm, ambery finish.

perfumes.name: Soleil de Jeddah
perfumes.description: Sun-drenched chamomile and apricot-tinged osmanthus glow over soft leather, the blazing sun of Jeddah reflected on the Red Sea. Ambergris, iris and vanilla give it a warm, animalic, golden radiance.

perfumes.name: Soleil de Jeddah Afterglow
perfumes.description: Chamomile and incense glow in the last light of a Jeddah sunset, with myrrh and iris butter warming the air. Benzoin, vetiver, vanilla and styrax leave a soft, resinous afterglow.

perfumes.name: Soleil de Jeddah Mango Kiss
perfumes.description: Ripe mango and coconut melt into chamomile and ylang-ylang, a sun-warmed kiss on a tropical beach. Vanilla, iris butter and benzoin give it a creamy, golden sweetness.

perfumes.name: Taklamakan
perfumes.description: Benzoin, labdanum and vanilla glow over guaiac wood and iris, a caravan crossing the endless Taklamakan desert at dusk. Patchouli, sandalwood and musk give it a warm, powdery, resinous depth.

perfumes.name: The Queen and the Viper
perfumes.description: Incense, bergamot and spearmint sharpen a dark brew of dates, tobacco and birch smoke, a queen's chamber guarded by a coiled viper. Resins, saffron and labdanum give it a sweet, smoky, ambery power.

perfumes.name: Une Nuit à Doha
perfumes.description: Honeyed tobacco and immortelle glow over fennel, ginger and mandarin, a warm night on a Doha rooftop overlooking the Gulf. Vanilla and vetiver give it a sweet, smooth, golden finish.

perfumes.name: Venom Incarnat
perfumes.description: Wild strawberries and raspberry drip with caramel over Russian leather, a poisoned fairy-tale apple gone deliciously wrong. Vanilla, tonka and patchouli give the sweetness a dark, seductive edge.

perfumes.name: Amber Room
perfumes.description: Golden amber glows with Turkish rose, coriander and spices, the legendary Amber Room of a Russian palace lit by candles. Cedar and bergamot keep the warmth bright and regal.

perfumes.name: Blue Heart
perfumes.description: Saffron and creamy coconut melt into orris, vanilla and tonka, a blue diamond glowing on velvet. White musk, nagarmotha and amber give it a soft, earthy, powdery sweetness.

perfumes.name: Bohemian Infusion
perfumes.description: Grapefruit, petitgrain and cardamom fizz with ginger, myrtle and artemisia, a free-spirited afternoon in an herb garden. Patchouli, ambroxan, labdanum and amber give it a warm, modern finish.

perfumes.name: Bold As Love
perfumes.description: Fresh ginger, pineapple and mandarin crackle over lavender and geranium, a guitar riff played loud and bold. Supple leather, vetiver and patchouli give it a confident, rock-and-roll depth.

perfumes.name: Bravi
perfumes.description: Creamy tuberose and golden honey sparkle with bitter orange and ginger, a standing ovation on an opera opening night. Walnut milk, vanilla and a hint of tobacco give it a warm, gourmand finish.

perfumes.name: Carved Oud
perfumes.description: Smooth agarwood is carved alongside cedar and patchouli, with green cardamom and pink pepper sparking at the edges. Musk, sandalwood and vanilla polish it into an elegant, wearable oud.

perfumes.name: Centre Stage
perfumes.description: Lavender and cardamom step into the spotlight with orris and orange blossom, the moment the curtain rises. Amberwood, styrax and a touch of animalic warmth make the applause last.

perfumes.name: Chords
perfumes.description: Golden honey and tobacco leaf glow over rich black leather, the opening chords of a blues song in a smoky bar. Bergamot, orange blossom and cedar give it a smooth, woody resonance.

perfumes.name: Cullinan Diamond
perfumes.description: A peppery rose rests on a bed of cashmere musk and orris, the brilliant cut of the world's largest diamond. Vanilla, amber and cedar give it a soft, powdery sparkle.

perfumes.name: Diadem
perfumes.description: Lavender, olibanum and cardamom glitter with saffron, a jewelled diadem catching candlelight in a royal chapel. Amber, patchouli and vanilla give it a warm, resinous depth.

perfumes.name: Fanfare
perfumes.description: Lemon, neroli and bergamot blaze like trumpets with vermouth, juniper berry and rosemary, a celebration on a sunny terrace. Vetiver, musk and patchouli keep it crisp and elegant.

perfumes.name: Green Pearl
perfumes.description: Crisp green apple, bergamot and neroli meet green tea and artemisia, a rare green pearl glistening in clear water. Oakmoss, musk and tonka give it a fresh, clean, elegant finish.

perfumes.name: Imperial Crown
perfumes.description: Elemi and black pepper flash over olibanum and leather, the imperial crown carried through a smoky cathedral. Guaiac wood and patchouli give it a dry, regal, resinous finish.

perfumes.name: Insignia
perfumes.description: A dram of whiskey meets bay leaf, fig and bitter orange, a royal insignia stamped in a wood-panelled club. Sandalwood, vetiver and suede give it a smooth, dry, distinguished finish.

perfumes.name: Noorolain Taif
perfumes.description: Precious Taif rose glows with coriander and pink pepper in a desert garden at dawn. A thread of agarwood, cashmere wood and amber gives the petals a warm, Arabian depth.

perfumes.name: Patiala
perfumes.description: A radiant rose sparkles with aldehydes and citrus, the famous diamond necklace of an Indian maharaja. Orange blossom, amber, musk and oakmoss give it a clean, luminous elegance.

perfumes.name: Peacock Throne
perfumes.description: Taif rose and orris root bloom on a throne of dark patchouli and vetiver, the jewelled seat of the Mughal emperors. Pink pepper and vanilla add a soft, powdery, earthy glow.

perfumes.name: Peregrina
perfumes.description: Damask rose and gardenia melt into golden caramel and vanilla, the legendary Peregrina pearl glowing against warm skin. Amber, myrrh and white musk give it a rich, powdery sweetness.

perfumes.name: Regent Leather
perfumes.description: Saffron and cardamom warm a rich heart of vanilla and animalic notes, the polished leather of a Regency carriage. Cedar, labdanum and gurjan balsam give it a smooth, resinous, aristocratic finish.

perfumes.name: Rivière
perfumes.description: Saffron and black pepper flow into Turkish rose and supple leather, a rivière of diamonds draped over black suede. Sage, carnation and nagarmotha add an earthy, smoky depth.

perfumes.name: Royal Sapphire
perfumes.description: Sparkling mandarin and bergamot open onto radiant orange blossom and jasmine, a royal sapphire glinting in Mediterranean sunlight. Warm amber, oakmoss and patchouli give it an elegant, glowing depth.

perfumes.name: Sceptre
perfumes.description: Velvety peach and ylang-ylang meet pink pepper and clove, a jewelled sceptre held high in a candlelit throne room. Myrrh, amber, ambergris and benzoin give it a rich, resinous, golden warmth.

perfumes.name: The Cora
perfumes.description: Wisteria, Bulgarian rose and jasmine bloom with spicy carnation and lily of the valley, a cascade of flowers named after a legendary diamond. Benzoin, patchouli, white musk and amber give it a warm, elegant base.

perfumes.name: The Hope
perfumes.description: Cinnamon, clove and myrrh glow with the deep blue fire of the legendary Hope diamond. Cedar, oud, immortelle and black amber give the spice a dark, resinous richness.

perfumes.name: Accento
perfumes.description: Juicy pineapple and green hyacinth sparkle over powdery iris and pink pepper, an Italian accent that is bright, playful and elegant. A soft bed of musk, amber and vetiver keeps it smooth and luminous.

perfumes.name: Alexandria II
perfumes.description: Rosewood, lavender and cinnamon open onto rose and cedar, the grandeur of an ancient library in Alexandria. Smooth oud, sandalwood, amber and vanilla give it a regal, powdery, woody depth.

perfumes.name: Alexandria Orientale
perfumes.description: Smoky agarwood and Bulgarian rose meet leather, basil and green apple in a spice market of an ancient eastern port. Tobacco leaf, cedar and vanilla give it a rich, dark warmth.

perfumes.name: Amabile
perfumes.description: Crisp green apple, Amalfi lemon and bergamot sparkle over Guatemalan cardamom, a sunny Italian piazza on a spring morning. Mexican vanilla, cedar and white musk give it a soft, lovable warmth.

perfumes.name: Aqua Regia
perfumes.description: Supple leather and black currant meet violet and orris root, an alchemist's laboratory dissolving gold. Patchouli, caramel, cedar and vanilla give it a powdery, woody, gilded finish.

perfumes.name: Astaral
perfumes.description: Precious shamama attar, rose and pink pepper glow over amberwood and labdanum, a starlit night in an Indian palace garden. Rich agarwood, amber, moss and patchouli give it a deep, resinous, majestic finish.

perfumes.name: Erba Gold
perfumes.description: Juicy melon, Brazilian orange and pear sparkle with lemon and ginger, a golden summer afternoon by an Italian pool. White musk, vanilla and amber give the fruit a soft, sunny warmth.

perfumes.name: Holysm
perfumes.description: Balsam fir, clary sage and smoky cade oil meet tobacco and caraway, a mountain hermitage warmed by a wood fire. Vietnamese oud, patchouli and sandalwood give it a dark, aromatic, almost sacred depth.

perfumes.name: More Than Words
perfumes.description: Smooth oud is softened by juicy fruits and a bouquet of flowers, a love letter that says more than words ever could. Ambergris, olibanum and labdanum give it a warm, resinous, ambery glow.

perfumes.name: Muse
perfumes.description: Dark plum and raspberry meet white flowers and soft leather, a muse posing for a painter in a velvet-draped studio. Amber, benzoin, labdanum and patchouli give the fruit a rich, chypre-like warmth.

perfumes.name: Naxos
perfumes.description: Golden honey and lavender drip over tobacco leaf, a sun-baked afternoon on the island of Naxos. Bergamot, cinnamon, vanilla and tonka bean make it sweet, warm and irresistibly smooth.

perfumes.name: Ouverture
perfumes.description: Fig leaf and juicy orange open the curtain over cinnamon, ylang-ylang and jasmine, the first notes of an opera overture. Sandalwood, amber, vanilla and incense give it a warm, golden finale.

perfumes.name: Soprano
perfumes.description: A lush Bulgarian rose sings with lychee and juicy fruits over a hint of milk and osmanthus, a soprano's aria in a gilded opera house. Oud, patchouli and soft leather give the high notes a velvety, dark depth.

perfumes.name: Torino 21
perfumes.description: Cool mint, lemon and basil burst over thyme and rosemary, a fresh herbal tonic sipped in a sunny Turin courtyard. Black currant, lavender and musk keep it crisp, green and endlessly refreshing.

perfumes.name: Via Cavour I
perfumes.description: Golden quince and white peach meet dark chocolate, red berries and Moroccan rose, a luxurious pâtisserie on Turin's Via Cavour. Caramel, vanilla, oud and amber make it rich, sweet and indulgent.

perfumes.name: Wardasina
perfumes.description: A deep Bulgarian rose wrapped in tobacco leaf and saffron, a rose garden at dusk with smoke drifting from a nearby pipe. Patchouli, cedar, musk and vanilla give it a dark, sweet, sophisticated warmth.
